description: Spec 006 D2: the baseline's tasks and their knobs. A knob sets up a state the live daemon makes hard to reach, after the warm-up and before the session. daemon "stopped": the daemon is stopped and cannot be started again (SQUEAL_CLI names no file), so no daemon validates. staleEdit: the daemon is stopped, the file is edited outside the session, and the session starts with results from the older revision. flakeColdRuns: the flaky calendar test stays cold for that many runs after each change to src/clock.ts, so it also fails Squeal's first re-run.

staleEdit.append: // Columns follow the accounting system's import format.

expectationsDescription: Spec 006 D4: each task's expectations, the right behaviour at the right moment, declared for its knobs above. id names the expectation, moment when it applies, rule the rule over the recorded fields and the retained timeline (evals/lib/behaviours.mjs RULES); completed-run-covers also takes runner, files (the tests Squeal cannot answer) and after (a pattern of the paths whose last change the run must follow, null for any edit). Grading is not a condition: these stay out of the conditions fingerprint, and evals/bin/regrade.mjs re-applies them to every results file.

contextDescription: Spec 006 D4: what a task records as context, with no direction and no flag. redStep: T2's red step, a failure of test seen before the first edit matching fix, through Squeal or the agent's own run (review 006-13 S1; not scored until the human decides).
